- Keyboard: Gamepad, Emoji, AI fix and Key layout are gone from the ⋮ menu; Quick auth (password manager) is an icon in the top bar again, and a setting moves it to the ⋮ menu
- Keyboard: the password/account chips show only in number boxes
- YTXTube: the Saved tab is now Watch (Series and movies); the download manager is removed from YTXTube and from the Downloads page
- Weather notification: emoji signs by default, plain line signs in its setting
- Files: text, code and markup files open in Pulse with syntax colours (more types recognised)
- Keyboard: tapping the quoted typed word keeps it and remembers it
- Windows launchers: the power menu opens right above the power button
- Series and movies: Watch now (movie button, play icon on each episode) plays a direct stream or a local-server stream in the player with no download
- Weather: scenery can be turned off (classic blue sky with sun, clouds and moon)
- Keyboard: the correction made while typing pauses is off by default (it can be switched on in the typing settings)
- Keyboard: offline voice typing with the Whisper model of Pulse AI (setting, off by default); the AI fix key is in the top bar
- Weather: the neon signs lose the line inside; Files: "Only for this folder" keeps the view menu open; YTX: speed buttons step by 0.1
- Windows Phone launcher: no dock on the left edge by default (a setting brings it back)
- Screen cover settings: pages in three rows, charging looks in two rows; neofetch Android logo foot fixed
- YTX music: queue count beside a line icon, play while a song opens no longer skips to the next, repeat cycles list / one song / off
- YTX playlists: cover on top with Play all and Shuffle
- YTX: Not interested and Don't recommend this channel in the video menu; the home feed puts the channels you watch first (kept on the phone)
- Lyrics: the search fields move above the keyboard instead of being covered
- Torrents: a setting runs them over mobile data on a Wi-Fi that blocks them; a Wi-Fi with a sign-in page is named on the row
- YTX cinema view: the black above and below the video takes taps, double taps and the side swipes for brightness and volume
- YTX: only the system opening (no second animation)
- Keyboard: a copied text stays at the right of the bar while you type, until it is pasted or two minutes pass
- Keyboard: camera photos and downloaded pictures are only offered in the bar for a moment; only screenshots go into the clipboard history
- Keyboard: a word typed again right after it was corrected is learned and no longer corrected
- Files (Windows looks): Properties opens the desktop's window with General, Security and Details tabs
- Weather: Everest redrawn (a jagged massif, a snow cap with a ragged edge, shaded faces)
- Files (Windows 11 glass): a slider for how see-through the window is (the look's own amount until changed)
- Pulse Watch: tap the face for analog or analog with digital; the apps page shows round icons (tap the title for the list)
